Company policy may oblige employees to report equipment damage before leaving their shift. (公司規定可能要求員工在下班前回報設備損壞。)
Management launched an investigation into the sudden occurrence of network errors. (管理層對突然發生的網路錯誤展開調查。)

meaning: a. 運作中的；營運上的
example: The company managed to reduce its operational costs by automating routine tasks. (該公司透過自動化日常任務來降低營運成本。)
A brief power outage interrupted the presentation, but the meeting resumed once backup lights turned on. (短暫停電中斷了簡報，不過備用照明亮起後會議便繼續進行。)
The organizer limited registration to avoid overcrowding the small auditorium during the product demonstration. (主辦人限制報名人數，以免產品示範期間小型演講廳過度擁擠。)

meaning: n. 法律助理；律師助理
example: The paralegal organized case documents and scheduled client interviews for the attorneys at the downtown firm. (法律助理整理案件文件，並替市中心事務所的律師安排客戶訪談。)
The shipment was partially damaged during transport, so the receiver documented the condition before signing. (貨物在運送途中部分受損，因此收貨人在簽收前記錄了狀況。)
The chef added pepper to the soup after tasting it and checking the recipe's seasoning instructions. (廚師品嚐湯品並查看食譜的調味指示後，加入了胡椒。)
The company permanently closed the outdated branch after moving its customer service operations to a larger center. (公司將客服業務遷至較大的中心後，永久關閉了老舊分店。)
Municipal crews plow the access road before employees arrive whenever heavy snow covers the industrial park. (只要大雪覆蓋工業園區，市政人員就會在員工抵達前鏟除聯外道路的積雪。)
The help desk received a query about renewing passwords and answered it before the end of the business day. (服務台收到一項關於更新密碼的詢問，並在營業日結束前回覆。)
The railway added evening service so commuters could return from the business district after late meetings. (鐵路公司增開晚間班次，讓通勤者在較晚的會議後能從商業區返家。)
The outdoor guide recommended a raincoat because the forecast called for showers during the afternoon tour. (戶外導覽員建議穿雨衣，因為預報指出下午行程期間可能有陣雨。)

meaning: v. 重新考慮；重新審議
example: The committee will reconsider the budget allocation if additional funding is secured. (如果獲得額外資金，委員會將重新考慮預算分配。)
The agency will redesign its website to make application forms easier to find on mobile devices. (該機構將重新設計網站，讓使用者更容易在行動裝置上找到申請表。)
The marketing team scheduled a final rehearsal before the live product launch event. (行銷團隊安排了現場產品發表會之前的最後一次排練。)
The hotel added a quiet lounge for relaxation where conference attendees can rest between afternoon sessions. (飯店增設一處安靜休息室，讓會議參加者能在下午議程之間放鬆休息。)
Avoiding the repetition of past logistical mistakes is key to improving efficiency. (避免重複過去的物流錯誤是提高效率的關鍵。)

meaning: n. 靜修活動；撤退；隱居處
example: Department leaders attended a two-day retreat to review long-term priorities away from their usual office routines. (部門主管參加為期兩天的靜修研討會，離開日常辦公節奏檢視長期優先事項。)
The new salon opened beside the hotel and offers appointments for visitors attending weekend conventions. (新美容院開在飯店旁，為參加週末會議的訪客提供預約服務。)
The company uses a satellite connection to provide reliable internet access at remote construction sites. (公司利用衛星連線，為偏遠施工地點提供可靠的網際網路服務。)

meaning: n. 風景；景色；舞台布景
example: The lakeside resort offers beautiful scenery for the executive board retreat. (湖畔度假村為董事會共識營提供優美景色。)

meaning: n. 連載作品；系列節目
example: The newspaper began a weekly serial about local business owners and the history of the downtown district. (報紙開始每週連載一篇介紹當地企業主與市中心歷史的故事。)
The costume assistant will sew a loose button back onto the jacket before the keynote speaker arrives. (服裝助理會在主講人抵達前，把外套上鬆脫的鈕扣縫回去。)
The architect prepared a sketch of the proposed lobby layout before meeting with the hotel management team. (建築師在與飯店管理團隊會面前，先準備了大廳配置的草圖。)
Employees can use a smartphone application to confirm deliveries and update inventory while away from the office. (員工可以使用智慧型手機應用程式，在離開辦公室時確認配送並更新庫存。)
Demand for semiconductor chips is expected to soar over the next calendar decade. (預計未來十年對半導體晶片的需求將激增。)

meaning: n. 刺激；促進因素；刺激措施
example: The city offered a tax stimulus to encourage manufacturers to expand operations in the industrial district. (市府提供稅務刺激措施，鼓勵製造商擴大在工業區的營運。)

meaning: n. 股票經紀人；證券經紀人
example: The stockbroker reviewed the client's investment goals before recommending changes to the retirement portfolio. (股票經紀人在建議調整退休投資組合前，先檢視了客戶的投資目標。)
The banquet staff replaced the tablecloth after a spilled drink stained the fabric near the head table. (飲料灑出弄髒主桌附近的布料後，宴會人員更換了桌布。)
Travelers became thirsty after walking through the outdoor exhibition, so staff distributed bottled water. (旅客走過戶外展區後感到口渴，因此工作人員分發了瓶裝水。)
The team felt a thrill when its design received the highest score at the regional innovation contest. (團隊的設計在區域創新競賽中獲得最高分時，大家都感到十分興奮。)
The contractor replaced one cracked tile in the hotel lobby before the conference registration desk opened. (承包商在會議報到櫃檯開放前，更換了飯店大廳一片破裂的磁磚。)

meaning: n. 盥洗用品；個人清潔用品
example: The hotel placed a toiletry kit in each guest room, including soap, shampoo, and a small toothbrush. (飯店在每間客房放置一套盥洗用品，包括肥皂、洗髮精和小牙刷。)
The legal department registered the new product name as a trademark before launching its advertising campaign. (法務部在推出廣告活動前，先將新產品名稱註冊為商標。)

meaning: a. 熱帶的；炎熱潮濕的
example: The resort's tropical garden features palms and flowering plants that remain colorful throughout the year. (度假村的熱帶花園種有棕櫚樹和全年色彩繽紛的開花植物。)
The caterer offered a tuna salad option for guests requesting a light lunch during the afternoon seminar. (外燴業者為下午研討會中想吃清淡午餐的賓客提供鮪魚沙拉。)

meaning: a. 失業的；沒有工作的
example: The training center offers computer classes to unemployed residents who are preparing to reenter the workforce. (訓練中心為準備重返職場的失業居民開設電腦課程。)

meaning: v. 確認有效；證實；驗證
example: Automated data entry systems can easily validate transaction records against history. (自動資料輸入系統可以輕鬆地根據歷史記錄驗證交易記錄。)
The bakery added vanilla to the cake mixture to give the dessert a mild, familiar flavor. (麵包店在蛋糕麵糊中加入香草，讓甜點帶有溫和熟悉的風味。)
